events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state, publish hold, keys, connector code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor 9787eef2 origin/main && echo PUSHED || echo NOTPUSHED; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys; grep -n "whatsapp" cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show key var names and recent Worker deployments
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env; ls cloud/wrangler*.toml cloud/*.jsonc 2>/dev/null; cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>&1 | tail -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare commit time with deploy, find Tantra API base
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log -1 --format='%ci %s' 9787eef2; git log --format='%h %ci' -3 origin/main -- cloud/src; grep -rn "api.usetantra\|TANTRA_BASE\|usetantra.com/api" cloud/src/*.ts | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Tantra API base URL and accounts endpoint usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rhoE "https://[a-z.]*usetantra\.com[^\"'\` ]*" cloud/src/*.ts | sort | uniq -c | head; grep -n "channels/accounts" cloud/src/*.ts | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Tantra URL builder
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "function tantraUrl\|TANTRA_API\b\|const TANTRA" -A3 cloud/src/*.ts | head -12
